label: executive of
definition: Person X holds or held an explicitly identified executive office in organization or governmental jurisdiction Y.
scope_notes: Includes: executive/chief executive office; corporate and county executive; explicit historical executive office. Excludes: chair/director/president/head alone without executive title; hired by an executive; candidate or nomination alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: title/attachment omits who holds the executive office.

facts.reason: Carleton S. Fiorina → Hewlett-Packard: Explicit executive title or taking office as executive establishes actual executive tenure; nomination or other title rows do not negate the direct role.

review.method: Explicit manual judgment after reading the full relation dictionary and every supplied case row; citations include the complete considered evidence.
